channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: ‘Não decidi se serei candidato ainda’, diz Lula sobre eleições de 2026
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva said he has not yet decided whether he will run for re-election in 2026, though he indicated it is very likely, with formalization expected at the PT’s June convention. He emphasized the need to rebuild a strong political alliance to prevent fascist forces from returning to power and announced he will submit a bill to Congress to end the 6×1 work schedule, reducing working hours without cutting wages.

item.title: Caso Master: Galípolo diz que não há auditoria ou sindicância que aponte culpa de Campos Neto
item.description: Central Bank President Gabriel Galípolo stated that no audit or investigation finds fault with former president Roberto Campos Neto in the Banco Master case, despite Lula government claims linking the scandal to Bolsonaro’s administration. Galípolo, who took office in January 2025 and ordered Master’s liquidation, avoided criticizing his predecessor and acknowledged his own decision is under scrutiny for being possibly hasty.

item.title: STF julga como será a eleição para mandato-tampão no governo do Rio
item.description: The STF is reviewing two actions regarding the interim election for Rio de Janeiro’s governorship after the resignation and removal of former Governor Cláudio Castro. The first, under Justice Luiz Fux’s rapporteurship, examines suspending parts of the law governing indirect elections, advocating for secret ballot and federal timelines for removal from office. The second, led by Justice Cristiano Zanin, assesses the suspension of indirect elections, with the PGR advocating for a direct vote.

item.title: Senador rompe com PT, cita ‘ganância’ do partido e muda de lado na Bahia
item.description: Senator Angelo Coronel broke with the PT in Bahia, claiming the party sought to monopolize all positions on the electoral slate due to 'greed,' blocking his re-election bid under the PSD. He switched to the Republicans and joined the state opposition, aligning with ACM Neto. Coronel also endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro nationally and framed the presidential election as a two-pole contest between Bolsonaro and Lula.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Meio/Ideia indica freio para Flávio Bolsonaro e alerta econômico para Lula
item.description: The Meio/Ideia poll shows a technical tie between Lula (40.4%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (37%), with the opposition candidate having reached an initial growth ceiling. Over 74% of voters cite cost of living and debt as major concerns, signaling an economic alert for the government.

item.title: Lula critica Flávio e Caiado sobre posicionamento sobre terras raras e chama Trump de imperador
item.description: Lula criticized Flávio Bolsonaro and Ronaldo Caiado for supporting the sale of Brazil's rare earths to the United States, calling Caiado's agreement a 'shame' and warning against the surrender of strategic assets. He also indirectly referred to Donald Trump as an 'emperor,' stressed the need to strengthen Brazil's defense industry, and positioned democracy as a central theme in the 2026 elections, including the abolition of the 6x1 work schedule.

item.title: “Essa gente vai vender o Brasil”, diz Lula sobre Flávio e Caiado
item.description: Lula accused Flávio Bolsonaro and Ronaldo Caiado of seeking to sell Brazil's strategic minerals to the United States, warning it would undermine national sovereignty. He emphasized Brazil holds the world's second-largest rare earth reserves and is establishing a National Council for Mineral and Rare Earth Policy to safeguard these resources as a national security priority.

item.title: Tarcísio inaugura primeira escola construída pela iniciativa privada
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) inaugurates on Friday (10) the first public school managed by private initiative in the state, located in Aguaí. The project represents a public-private partnership model in education, with construction and management of the school carried out by private entities.

item.title: STF julga hoje ações que discutem a eleição para o governo do Rio
item.description: The STF is today judging two PSD actions questioning the rules of the Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial election, specifically whether the vote will be direct or indirect. State leadership is currently held by Ricardo Couto, president of the TJ-RJ, who assumed office after Claudio Castro's resignation, one day before his cassation by the TSE.

item.title: Quem é Augusto Cury, anunciado como pré-candidato à Presidência
item.description: Augusto Cury, a psychiatrist and writer from Colina (SP), has been announced as a pre-candidate for the Presidency in the 2026 Brazilian elections. Author of over 70 books translated into 70 languages and with more than 25 million copies sold in Brazil, he emphasizes his mental health expertise and cultural influence.

item.title: O recado de Lula ao avisar que ainda não se decidiu sobre disputar eleição
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated he has not yet decided whether to run for re-election in 2026, sparking debate over his true intentions. Analysts suggest the remark is a tactical move to pressure the Workers' Party (PT) into ensuring unity, broadening alliances, and mobilizing the base amid rising poll numbers for Flávio Bolsonaro. While the statement risks conveying uncertainty, it is seen as an internal mobilization tool rather than a sign of withdrawal.

item.title: Moraes inclui na pauta julgamento sobre regulamentação de delações premiadas
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has placed on the docket a 2021 PT lawsuit seeking constitutional limits on plea bargains, aiming to uphold due process and the presumption of innocence. The action challenges practices such as using cross-delation as evidence and advocates for the accused to have the final word in all proceedings. The case, tied to Operation Car Wash, also raises concerns about potential conflicts of interest involving Moraes and former Banco Master CEO Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: STF AO VIVO – Eleições para mandato tampão de governador do Rio de Janeiro – sessão 8/4/2026
item.description: The Brazilian Supreme Court (STF) will rule on Wednesday (April 8, 2026) on the method for selecting the interim governor of Rio de Janeiro — whether by direct popular vote or indirect vote by the state legislature — in cases filed by the PSD. The court will also resume judgment on the Ferrogrão railway’s environmental impact and assess the constitutionality of the 'Lei Ferrari,' which the PGR argues undermines free enterprise, consumer rights, and economic competition.

item.title: Lula diz que penduricalhos são promiscuidade e volta a criticar verbas do Congresso
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) again criticized the so-called 'penduricalhos', referring to budgetary allocations concentrated in the National Congress, particularly the 'secret budget' that allows lawmakers to direct funds without clear identification. He described such practices as promiscuous and reiterated his opposition to the discretionary use of parliamentary funds. The remarks were made on Wednesday, April 8, 2026, during a public event.

item.title: Lula diz ter aconselhado Moraes a se declarar impedido no caso Master: 'Não permita que caso Vorcaro jogue fora sua biografia'
item.description: Lula said he advised Minister Alexandre de Moraes to recuse himself from judging the Master case involving banker Daniel Vorcaro, due to the contract between Banco Master and the law firm of Viviane Barci de Moraes, Moraes' wife. He told Moraes he had built a historic biography through the January 8 ruling and should not let the Vorcaro case ruin it. Lula also stated that the Master case harms the image of the Supreme Court.

item.title: Líder do PT critica governo por indefinição na escala 6x1: Constrangimento'
item.description: PT leader in the Chamber of Deputies, Pedro Uczai, criticized the government for its indecision on ending the 6x1 work schedule, saying conflicting statements caused embarrassment within the allied base. He urged the government to make a clear decision: either send an urgent bill or support existing proposals. The episode revealed tensions between the Planalto and Congress over strategy, as unions push for reform amid business resistance.

item.title: Lula disse para eu ser técnico após reunião com Vorcaro, diz Galípolo
item.description: Central Bank President Gabriel Galípolo stated that President Lula instructed him to act in a technical manner during a December 2024 meeting with Daniel Vorcaro, founder of Banco Master, emphasizing autonomy to avoid persecution or protection of any party. Galípolo also confirmed receiving directives to avoid "pirotechnics" and to remain as technical as possible in his decisions, despite the ongoing Organized Crime Parliamentary Inquiry (CPI) investigating the Master scandal.

item.title: Ajufe elege presidente mulher pela 1ª vez
item.description: Federal judge Ana Lya Ferraz da Gama Ferreira was elected the first woman president of the Ajufe for the 2026-2028 biennium, receiving 94.14% of valid votes in the uncontested 'Ajufe em Frente' slate. The electronic election involved 1,298 members, with 76 blank ballots. Her inauguration is scheduled for June 10, 2026, in Brasília.

item.title: Lula bancou autonomia técnica do BC em reunião com Vorcaro, diz Galípolo a CPI
item.description: The president of the Central Bank, Gabriel Galípolo, told the Senate's Organized Crime CPI that President Lula directed that the monetary authority's actions in the Banco Master case be strictly technical, without political interference, during a December 2024 meeting with banker Daniel Vorcaro. Galípolo stated that Lula emphasized the BC's technical autonomy, urging investigation without protecting or pursuing anyone, and noted that Vorcaro's claims of financial market persecution did not align with sector realities. The meeting, not on the president's official agenda, included ministers and was later described by Vorcaro as 'excellent' and 'very strong' in messages obtained by the Federal Police.

item.title: O recado de Lula a Alexandre de Moraes sobre o escândalo do Banco Master
item.description: President Lula stated that he gave a message to Minister Alexandre de Moraes of the STF regarding the scandal involving Banco Master and the law firm of Moraes' wife, Viviane Barci de Moraes. Lula said he urged Moraes not to let the case damage his historical biography built through the January 8 ruling, and that he should recuse himself from cases involving his wife, even if she does not need his permission to act. The president emphasized that while the action may be legal, it could appear immoral in the eyes of the public and harm the STF's image.

item.title: Valdemar afirma que Bolsonaro ficará dez anos preso em caso de derrota de Flávio na eleição
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL, stated that if Flávio Bolsonaro does not win the 2026 presidential election, Jair Bolsonaro will remain imprisoned for ten more years. He made the remark during a Bradesco investment event in São Paulo, emphasizing the need to prevent internal conflict within the base, particularly between Eduardo Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira. Valdemar also blamed Bolsonaro's 'stubbornness' in 2022 for keeping Braga Netto as running mate and rejecting Tereza Cristina, which he said alienated female voters and led to Lula's victory.

item.title: Lula afirma que governo vai enviar projeto de escala 6x1 nesta semana
item.description: President Lula announced that the government will send a bill to Congress this week to end the 6x1 work schedule, reducing working hours without cutting wages, citing productivity gains from technological innovation. He stressed the need to include loopholes for sector-specific negotiations, allowing certain categories to maintain the 6x1 schedule via agreements. The move coincides with a constitutional amendment (PEC) on the same issue already under review in the Chamber’s CCJ, which enjoys strong public support (71% per Datafolha) but faces opposition from business sectors.

item.title: Lula relaciona Bolsonaro e Campos Neto ao escândalo do banco Master
item.description: President Lula blamed the Bolsonaro government for the origin of the Banco Master scandal and accused former Central Bank president Roberto Campos Neto of placing the 'serpent's egg' that enabled it. He also called for increased defense spending amid global geopolitical threats and accused pre-candidates Flávio Bolsonaro and Ronaldo Caiado of planning to sell the country through privatization.

item.title: Se depender de mim, a gente fecha as bets, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) stated that, if it were up to him, betting companies (bets) would be shut down in Brazil, emphasizing that the government is seriously discussing the issue but depends on Congress. He rejected the argument that football needs bets, noting the sport thrived for over a century without them, and warned that gambling is now accessible at home, leading people to spend money to enrich betting firms. Lula also implied that known deputies, senators, and parties are involved in the sector, without naming them.

item.title: Eleições do RJ: entenda como o voto de Cármen Lúcia deve influenciar a Corte
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court is set to rule on Wednesday (Apr 8, 2026) whether a direct or indirect election should fill the vacancy in the Rio de Janeiro governorship following Claudio Castro's resignation. Minister Cármen Lúcia, president of the TSE, is expected to influence the decision based on logistical feasibility and potential impact on the 2026 majoritarian elections. The Electoral Prosecutor’s Office supports a direct election, stating the vacancy stems from an electoral cause, though concerns remain about the tight timeline before June.

item.title: Lula diz ter aconselhado Moraes a não jogar biografia fora e a se declarar impedido de votar sobre Master
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) stated that alleged frauds involving the Master bank and the involvement of Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes' wife in the bank's defense harm the court's image. He said he advised Moraes not to discard his biography and to recuse himself from voting on matters related to the bank due to potential conflict of interest.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro quer trocar candidato ao TCU para favorecer petista e garantir vaga ao PL em 2027
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president in 2026, is negotiating within the PL to remove Hélio Negão (PL-RJ) from the TCU race, aiming to benefit the candidacy of petista Odair Cunha (PT-MG) and secure a strategic position for the PL in the 2027 elections. The maneuver reflects a political agreement between opposition and government forces to balance influence in the audit court.

item.title: Lula diz que caso Master afeta a imagem do STF e revela conversa com Moraes: 'Não permita que Vorcaro jogue fora sua biografia
item.description: Lula states that the Master case harms the image of the Supreme Court and reveals he advised Minister Alexandre de Moraes not to let his wife’s involvement undermine his legacy, built through the January 8 ruling. He argued that while the action may be legal, it appears immoral to the public under current circumstances, and that the far right will exploit the case in the 2026 election campaign. Lula emphasized the need for a clear, convincing explanation to society to prevent the issue from being buried or politically manipulated.

item.title: Gesto de Lula para acelerar fim da escala 6×1 irrita Centrão e azeda relação com Congresso
item.description: President Lula is considering sending a bill with constitutional urgency to end the 6×1 work schedule, aiming to speed up its approval in Congress. However, the move has angered the Centrão and opposition, who see it as unilateral and provocative, risking further deterioration of relations between the Executive and Legislative branches. Despite government allies denying statements by House Speaker Hugo Motta that no such bill would be sent, the plan remains under discussion without alignment with congressional leadership.

item.title: CPI do Crime Organizado ouve presidente do BC, Gabriel Galípolo; Campos Neto falta pela 3ª vez
item.description: The President of the Central Bank, Gabriel Galípolo, testified before the Organized Crime CPI regarding the BC's role in the Banco Master case, denying undue influence and asserting technical autonomy. Former BC President Roberto Campos Neto missed the hearing for the third time, being cited as a qualified witness to explain delays in investigating fraud linked to Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Ibovespa dispara com alívio geopolítico e trégua no Oriente Médio
item.description: The Ibovespa surged to 191,440 points amid geopolitical relief as the U.S. postponed its ultimatum to Iran, easing Middle East tensions and boosting bank stocks such as Bradesco, Santander, Banco do Brasil and Itaú. The dollar fell to R$ 5.15 and Wall Street futures rose sharply, reflecting global optimism over the potential normalization of oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Lula defende mais investimento em defesa e acusa oposição de planejar vender o país
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that Brazil must strengthen its defense amid the global geopolitical scenario, emphasizing the urgency of investing in the defense industry to ensure national sovereignty and prevent invasions. He accused the opposition, specifically pre-candidates Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), of planning to 'sell Brazil' through privatizations, and criticized a 'citizen who thinks he is an emperor' in reference to the international situation.

item.title: Messias recomeça peregrinação no Senado
item.description: Jorge Messias begins today a new round of visits to Senate offices to secure the 41 votes needed for his nomination to the STF, resuming an effort first undertaken at the end of 2023. These visits are part of the constitutional process for approving Supreme Court nominees, requiring qualified senatorial support.

item.title: UP lança pré-candidatura de Samara Martins à Presidência
item.description: The Popular Unity (UP) party launched the pre-candidacy of Samara Martins for president of Brazil in the 2026 elections, unanimously approved by the party. Samara, a dentist and SUS worker in Rio Grande do Norte, is national coordinator of the Black Revolutionary Front and national vice-president of UP. Her candidacy frames itself as a response to working-class demands against outsourcing, informalization, gig economy exploitation, exhausting work hours, low wages, and violence against women and Black Brazilians.

item.title: Para Lula, é hora de acabar com os “penduricalhos” no país
item.description: President Lula stated that Brazil must eliminate 'penduricalhos' — public funds distributed politically without technical criteria to favor parties or lawmakers — criticizing the secret budget and party/electoral funds as sources of political promiscuity that hinder renewal. He stressed these practices are incorrect for both the Executive and Congress, noting resistance even within his own PT party. Lula labeled the secret budget 'the biggest corruption in 200 years of the Republic' and the nearly R$60 billion in amendments as abnormal.

item.title: Lula diz que “meninada” da seleção joga 10% do que jogava Pelé
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva said the current Brazilian national team plays only 10% of what Pelé did, despite earning 100 times more. He criticized the absence of famous players at Pelé’s funeral and noted Pelé’s modest wealth, coming from a construction materials depot in Santos. Lula emphasized the need to develop both athletic skill and civic values in young athletes.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: STF decide futuro do Rio de Janeiro
item.description: The STF is reviewing the format of the election for Rio de Janeiro's interim governorship, while the Chamber of Deputies debates the dispute over the TCU ministerial vacancy. Meio-Dia em Brasília highlights these two central topics of the national political agenda.

item.title: Lula diz que Flávio e Caiado 'vão vender o Brasil' ao falar de terras raras
item.description: President Lula accused Flávio Bolsonaro and Ronaldo Caiado of seeking to 'sell Brazil' by negotiating with the U.S. over rare earth minerals, likening it to giving away national oil resources. He criticized Caiado’s agreement with a U.S. company, signed while he was governor of Goiás, calling it a 'shame' for involving concessions only the federal government can authorize. Lula framed the issue as a matter of national sovereignty, leveraging it in his campaign amid a technical tie with Flávio Bolsonaro in recent 2026 election polls.

item.title: É falso que Flávio Bolsonaro disse que vai acabar com o Pix
item.description: It is false that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro said he would end Pix to please Donald Trump. The image circulating on social media is a montage that falsifies the visual identity of the Estado de Minas newspaper, and there is no record of such a statement by the senator. Flávio labeled the claim a 'PT lie' and emphasized that Pix is a Brazilian heritage, although he incorrectly stated that the Lula government attempted to tax Pix, which did not happen.

item.title: Lula diz que não permitirá acordo de minerais críticos feito por Caiado sem respaldo da União
item.description: President Lula stated that Governor Ronaldo Caiado could not have signed the critical minerals agreement with the United States without federal backing, emphasizing that such deals require union authorization. Caiado had signed a memorandum of understanding on cooperation last month. Lula reinforced national sovereignty over strategic resources.

item.title: Lula defende guarda nacional para “pronta intervenção”
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva advocated for the creation of a national guard for 'prompt intervention' in scenarios such as blockades or attempts by factions to take over cities, stating that the world now demands Brazil take security more seriously. He also announced that the Ministry of Public Security will be established the week following the approval of the Public Security PEC in Congress, complete with its own budget, to enable federal action, as security is currently largely the responsibility of states under the Constitution.

item.title: Lula tem 56% das intenções de voto em PE, diz pesquisa
item.description: In Pernambuco, Lula leads with 56% of voting intentions in the 1st round, with a 2-point margin of error, suggesting a possible first-round victory. Flávio Bolsonaro follows with 25%, then Ronaldo Caiado (6%), Romeu Zema and Renan Santos (2% each). In a potential runoff, Lula reaches 59% against Bolsonaro (32%) and 62% against Caiado (25%).

item.title: ‘Eu não decidi se serei candidato ainda’, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated he has not yet decided whether to run for re-election in 2026, saying he must present a new and strong program for the country before making a decision. He acknowledged that, despite positive government actions, the situation remains difficult and stressed the need to rebuild a political alliance capable of defeating the opposition, which he described as 'fascist'.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro diz que não pode ‘aceitar ser humilhado’ por Nikolas Ferreira
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro publicly criticized federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira, stating he cannot 'accept being humiliated' by him amid internal bolsonarist tensions. Eduardo emphasized his role in boosting Nikolas’ political career, including campaign support, event appearances, and social media backing, while calling for unity and coherence within the right, noting this would be his final comment on the matter.

item.title: Lula faz viagem à Europa este mês: Lisboa, Barcelona e Hannover no roteiro
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will travel to Europe in the second half of April, visiting Lisbon, Barcelona, and Hannover. The agenda includes political meetings and participation in international events.

item.title: As apostas que Izalci Lucas faz para desbancar o apoio de Michelle Bolsonaro a Celina Leão ao governo do DF
item.description: Senator Izalci Lucas (PL-DF) maintains his pre-candidacy for the Distrito Federal governorship, despite former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro’s support for Celina Leão (PP-DF). He believes Michelle may reconsider her backing based on internal PL projections showing him ahead in the race and ongoing allegations involving the Bank of Brasília (BRB), which he claims reveal a pattern of governance that places private interests above public responsibility.

item.title: Apesar de incômodos, prefeitos veem Tarcísio competitivo sem depender do interior
item.description: Mayors from the interior of São Paulo acknowledge that Governor Tarcísio de Freitas has sufficient political capital to run for re-election without relying directly on municipal support, attributing his strength mainly to bolsonarismo. Despite expressing discomfort over lack of attention to local demands, the governor’s limited presence in the interior, and reduced investments such as ICMS payments, most intend to maintain their support in the 2026 elections. The arrival of Roberto Carneiro at the Palácio dos Bandeirantes may ease tensions, though mayors admit local leaders could still influence electoral outcomes in certain municipalities, with possible vote shifts to opponents like Fernando Haddad depending on mayoral engagement.

item.title: Campos Neto não vai à CPI do Crime Organizado sobre o Master
item.description: Roberto Campos Neto, former president of the Central Bank, refused to attend the Parliamentary Inquiry Committee on Organized Crime regarding the Banco Master case for the second time, despite being summoned. Founder Daniel Vorcaro is imprisoned and under investigation for corruption and money laundering, while current BC president Gabriel Galípolo confirmed his attendance and had an undisclosed meeting with Vorcaro and Lula in December 2024. BRB, after purchasing Master’s loan portfolios for R$ 12.2 billion, faces liquidation risk following the discovery of a nearly R$ 52 billion hole in the FGC.

item.title: As férias, a licença de Sidônio e a campanha de Lula
item.description: Sidônio Palmeira, Minister of Secom, will take 15 days of vacation in June to structure the marketing for Lula's re-election campaign. He will remain in office until September-October, when he will request leave to work directly on the campaign between the first and second rounds of the 2026 elections, returning to his post regardless of the outcome to complete Lula's third term.

item.title: TSE celebra Dia Nacional do Sistema Braille nesta quarta-feira (8)
item.description: The TSE celebrated National Braille Day, emphasizing the accessibility of electronic voting machines for visually impaired voters. Since 2000, the machines have included audio output and Braille-labeled keyboards, ensuring secret and independent voting. Brazil has 294,576 voters with visual disabilities, whose participation is guaranteed by the Electoral Justice.
